verdict.rationale: Asana's own marketing documents built-in AI agents. 'AI Teammates' are pre-built agents that work alongside the team inside real workflows, with shared memory, scoped permissions and audit trails, plus an 'AI Chief of Staff' (Asana Dash) and AI Studio. The evidence does not show how a user actually assigns or delegates a specific task to these agents, and all of it is vendor marketing without hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: documented task-delegation or assignment flow to AI Teammates, in-depth product docs on what the assistant can execute, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Pre-built AI agents that work alongside your team inside real workflows, with shared memory, governance, and context from the Work Graph
Turn your team's collective expertise into custom AI Teammates built to handle the complex, coordination-heavy work that slows your team down.
Shared memory means AI Teammates learn from the work itself.
Every agent has an identity, scoped permissions, an audit trail, and cost constraints
